meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 能翻查你以往所有会话留下的记忆:先搜出带编号的索引表,筛掉不相关的,再只取回相关几条的完整内容,从而回答以前做过什么。
howto.when: 当你问「这个问题以前解决过吗」「上次 X 是怎么做的」「上周发生了什么」等关于以往会话(而非当前对话)的问题时触发。

say.text: 搜一下以前的会话,看我们有没有修过认证相关的问题
say.note: 先返回带编号的索引表供你筛选

say.text: 上周这个项目都改了什么?
say.note: 按日期范围搜索过往记录

say.text: 把 #11131、#10942 这几条的完整内容取回来
say.note: 一次请求批量取回详情

howto.what_en: It lets Claude search the persistent cross-session memory of your past work: first an index table with IDs, then full details only for the few entries you pick, so it can answer what was done before.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current chat, e.g. "did we already fix this?", "how did we solve X last time?", or "what happened last week?".

say_en.text: Search past sessions for whether we already fixed auth issues
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs first

say_en.text: What changed in this project last week?
